meta.title: Changelog — what shipped in MepMail
meta.description: Every recent MepMail release, newest first — what changed for you, and the day it shipped.

hero.title: What <highlight>shipped</highlight>, release by release.
hero.lead: MepMail is built in the open. Here is every recent release, newest first — what changed for you, dated the day it shipped. The raw history lives in the repository's CHANGELOG.md.
hero.note: The beta is open and self-serve: create a free account, no card required.

feed.title: Recent releases
feed.body: The six most recent releases. Older history lives in the repository changelog.

releases.title: 10% more email on every plan
releases.summary: Every plan sends 10% more email for the same price — plus a way back from sign-in and a website that leads with what you get.

items: Sign-in and sign-up now link back to the site, so you're never stranded mid-flow.
Official, full-colour logos for every service MepMail connects to, across the site and the product.
Quotas up 10% everywhere: Pro now starts at 110,000 emails/month and Scale reaches 2.75M. Prices unchanged.

releases.title: Roomier plans and pages you can trust
releases.summary: More domains and workspaces per plan, unlimited contacts on Starter, and two new pages that explain security and support up front.

items: /security — the controls that protect your sending, the services we rely on, and exactly where compliance (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) stands.
/support — how to reach us and what to expect, with an FAQ for larger teams.
/integrations — every service that connects to MepMail, with a setup guide per tool.
More domains and workspaces per plan; unlimited contacts on Starter.
Prices display correctly in each language.

releases.title: Alerts in Slack, Discord and Telegram — and ready-made templates
releases.summary: Get notified where your team already talks, and start from 10 ready-to-use email templates.

items: Notification channels for Slack, Discord and Telegram — paste a webhook URL and MepMail formats the alerts.
A gallery of 10 ready-to-use email templates (EN and PT) with live preview and one-click copy.

releases.title: Your AI agents can discover MepMail
releases.summary: The MCP server now advertises itself where agent tools look, and the docs got a big first pass.

items: MCP auto-discovery: Claude and other MCP clients can now find MepMail's tools without manual setup.
For self-hosters: an operator console to manage instance users, audit and regions.
Docs wave 1 — npm packages, rate limits with Retry-After, a full error catalogue, and the MCP install path.

releases.title: Open beta: sign up and send today
releases.summary: No invite needed — create an account and start sending. Docs and search visibility improved along the way.

items: Open sign-up: no invite, no waiting list. The Free plan sends 100 emails/day, no card required.
A doctor command in the migration CLI to check your setup, plus emails list/get.
Docs and legal pages are now search-engine friendly — easier to find when you're googling an error.
The mobile header stays put, with the sign-up button always visible.

releases.title: Terms, Privacy and Refunds — in plain language
releases.summary: The legal pages you expect, plus a landing that shows the product instead of describing it.

items: Terms, Privacy and Refund policies, in English and Portuguese.
A landing built around the product: a live demo, the founders program and straight answers in the FAQ.

close.title: See the next release as it lands.
close.body: Create a free account and follow the product from the inside — the beta is open, no card required.
